####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: This script produces descriptive statistics and various plots (maps, histograms, 
density plots) based on the final data sets (s08). It creates visual summaries of study 
participants, study locations, vaccination dates, immunogenicity measurements, and additional maps 
for selected pathogens.
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
library(nasapower)
library(tidygeocoder)
theme_set(theme_classic())
```

# Read in the data (only s08 data)
```{r}
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))

# Define selected pathogens for the manuscript figure
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Combine data for selected pathogens and standardize country names
```{r}
datsel_l <- bind_rows(dat_l[pat_sel], .id = "pat") %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat))
```

# Obtain longitude and latitude for each study 
```{r}
loc_geo <- distinct(datsel_l, study, country, lon_med, lat_med)
```

# Extract climate for each study 
```{r}
clim_l <- list()
for(stu in unique(loc_geo$study)) {
  clim_l[[stu]] <- pomp::bake(
    file = glue("{dirs$processed}/05_stu_nasapower/stu_nasapower_{stu}.rds"), dir = "", {
      # For each study, identify each distinct coordinate pair
      datstu <- filter(loc_geo, study == stu)
      # For each coordinate pair, extract the daily climate variables for 10 years
      datnasa <- lapply(1:length(datstu$study), function(x) {
        nasapower::get_power(
          community = "ag",
          lonlat = c(datstu$lon_med[x], datstu$lat_med[x]),
          pars = c("RH2M","T2M","T2MDEW","PS","QV2M","TQV", "PRECTOTCORR", "CLOUD_AMT", "EVPTRNS"),
          dates = c("2013-01-01", "2023-12-31"),
          temporal_api = "daily") %>%
          as.data.frame() %>% 
          rename_with(~tolower(paste0("clim_",.x))) %>%
          mutate(study = datstu$study[x],
                 country = datstu$country[x], 
                 lon_med = datstu$lon_med[x], 
                 lat_med = datstu$lat_med[x])
        }) %>%
        bind_rows() %>%
        select(-c(clim_lon, clim_lat)) %>%
        select(study, country, lon_med, lat_med, everything())
      # Bake per study
      return(datnasa)
    })
  }

bind_rows(clim_l)
```

# Summarise data per week  
```{r}
all_clim <- pomp::bake(
    file = glue("{dirs$processed}/05_stu_nasapower/all_clim.rds"), dir = "", { 
      bind_rows(clim_l) %>%
        # Obtain week
        mutate(week = week(clim_yyyymmdd)) %>%
        select(-c(clim_year, clim_mm, clim_dd, clim_doy, clim_yyyymmdd)) %>%
        # Obtain mean per week
        group_by(study, country, lon_med, lat_med, week) %>%
        summarise(across(starts_with("clim_"), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
        pivot_longer(starts_with("clim_"), names_to = "clim") %>%
        # Normalized mean per week
        group_by(study, country, lon_med, lat_med, clim) %>%
        mutate(value_norm = value - mean(value)) %>%
        ungroup()
})
```

# Plot it 
```{r}
all_clim %>%
  filter(clim %in% c("clim_rh2m", "clim_t2m", "clim_t2mdew", "clim_cloud_amt")) %>%
  filter(country %in% unique(all_clim$country)[10:15]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = value_norm, x = week, color = country, group = paste0(country, lon_med, lat_med))) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(clim~country, scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
